title: Classify EUR battle phase thresholds
changes: Identify an independent three-byte phase-threshold source at 37101c used by a battle task; the original signed phase index is not clamped before lookup.
validation: Wine e148-battle-37101d-dis-wine-hykbr3_9 shows 080131d6 loading 37101c, 080131e0 sign-extending the live phase, 080131e8 reading the threshold, and the subsequent phase increment/wrap only after comparison. Wine e145-battle-residue-wine-3pq4rwye observes phase-1 and phase-2 reads in the retained EUR battle window. The three source bytes have SHA-256 ee8357f0303dac80be96e10b1b49913c294c163771824fca6152057a6e1da957, equal in value but independent of the older 371064 source.
limitations: Phase 0 ordinary use, prelookup out-of-range inputs, managed serving, other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
